items.question: Any banned phrase present?
items.note: None in the page copy or the six embedded lessons (lib/learn_page.test.mjs greps the visible text for the CLAUDE.md list plus coming soon, limited, countdown).

items.question: Is 'free' used at most twice?
items.note: Once: the Free badge under the course eyebrow. The form, the routing panel and the lessons do not use the word.

items.question: No countdown, no 'limited', no fake counts, no 'coming soon'?
items.note: None. The video slot is hidden rather than promised; the below route offers nothing rather than pointing at a Capital Position page that does not exist yet.

items.question: Does the form have six fields and no phone number?
items.note: First name, email, and apply.html's four questions verbatim (channel, rev, model, skus). No phone or tel field. The honeypot is off-screen and aria-hidden.

items.question: Is lesson one readable without the form?
items.note: L1 is static HTML with no hidden or data-gated attribute; L2 to L6 are <section hidden data-gated>. The template button is the only locked element above the lesson.

items.question: Does any sentence claim results, clients or testimonials that do not exist?
items.note: The footer states there are no published results. The routing panel describes the Profit Teardown as a service, not an outcome. L6 asks the reader for a result and says that is the only proof the course will carry.

items.question: Does every dollar figure in the lessons trace to facts.json and carry a demo label?
items.note: content/tests/test_lessons_figures.py: every $ and % figure across L1 to L6 is a value in content/videos/playbook/facts.json, and every lesson with a dollar figure names the demo catalogue or demo data.

items.question: Luxury pass: no urgency, no scarcity, no exclamation marks, one CTA?
items.note: No exclamation mark in visible copy. The form's submit is the only amber button while locked; the template button is styled secondary until the form unlocks it and the form then hides.

notes: Two gaps that are not copy faults: the nav's All courses link points at /learn, which P1-learn-hub builds next; and the below route shows no Capital Position link until POSITION_URL is set on both the page and api/learn.js.
